description: This is a Python test script for a hardware abstraction layer (HAL) related to Ethernet switch (ethsw). It uses the tdklib library to load modules, configure test cases, invoke specific API functions, and verify behavior when no client devices are connected to the switch.

classes.name: TDKScriptingLibrary
classes.description: A class provided by the tdklib library to facilitate scripting and testing of modules.

methods.name: configureTestCase
methods.description: Configures the test case with IP, port, and test name.

methods.name: getLoadModuleResult
methods.description: Checks if the required module is successfully loaded.

methods.name: createTestStep
methods.description: Creates a test step object for executing specific API calls.

methods.name: setLoadModuleStatus
methods.description: Sets the status after attempting to load a module.

methods.name: unloadModule
methods.description: Unloads the specified module after testing.
